method: closing critic:monsters, fighter-review method. Sheet: node art/tools/three_snapshot.mjs art/out/units/<id>.glb --unit (before: _harness/_shots/fw_CW4_m_before_<id>.png; after: art/renders/units/<id>.png). In game: node _harness/value_probe.mjs --maps rift --tiers high --monsters only --t 370|70 (RIFT, 1920x1080, 28.5 m, fog off, the camps forced visible) -> _harness/_reports/fw_CW4_monsters.json (tags fw_CW4_mon_before, fw_CW4_mon_after1, fw_CW4_mon_after2, fw_CW4_mon_after1_t70) and shots _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_<tag>_mon_<id>.png. hp = std of display L* minus its 5x5 masked box mean inside the unit's faces (the E1 landmark metric); breakup = p95-p5 of the 0.5 m band (needs >= 0.5 m faces: 0 on small units); dL/dE76 against the floor ring 0.6-2.5 m past the unit's screen box; maxIoU = silhouette IoU (32x32 square-padded screen box) with the most similar other kind.
gate: hp >= the lane's hp (the E1 landmark bar) and breakup >= 6 where the faces allow; |dL*| >= 20 against the camp floor; L* p90 <= 86; no eye pair or face on a stone figure; sensitivity: no tall/pointed hood, no horror mask
ruling: owner ruling 1 (owner_rulings.md): the ink tears are removed, the chalk plate reads as a sundial with a brass hour-line inlay, lamp eyes kept (lamp eyes on a monster are allowed; the no-face rule is for Wicks)
verified: art/blender/units/creatures_b.py:1328 (tears removed, W5a commit cc7dc7f5); sheet _harness/_shots/fw_CW4_m_before_longshade.png shows the plate with two lamp eyes and no tear streaks

inGame.note: from the first fw_CW4_mon_before run at --t 1000 (shot _harness/_shots/value_rift_high_fw_CW4_mon_before_mon_longshade.png; the report key was later overwritten by the --t 370 run of the same tag)

findings: minor (not in this package's scope): the ink-shade body sits at L* p50 4.5 on a floor of 16.3 and its billows have little face detail (hp 0.65 < lane 1.19): a dark-on-dark read; a value lift on the crest billows would be the next Longshade pass

round2.note: Dusk-violet body with pale billow crests and chalk hour lines across the shadow-tail: dL* +24.5 (was -11.9), hp 1.49 (was 0.66), breakup 12.1 (was 3.8). Weakness by eye: the billows read as smooth bubbles rather than smoke, the limbs are plain.

round3.note: Ruling 1 read at the game camera: brass gnomon and at least five hour lines on the chalk plate survive at 28.5 m, inside a ring of twelve chalk hour stones. Rebuild budget of the package used (3): forearms and claws left for a later pass.

round3_refix1.changes: Refix 1: plumes are broad billows that taper into two torn licks, with soft washes instead of vein lines; chalk hour bands on the forearms; chalked knuckles; short stout claws (0.34-0.48 m, were 0.62-0.88). 974 KiB, 11829 tris.
round3_refix1.sensitivity: Crown plumes stay laid back and low, tips close round, plate unchanged (ruling 1). No hood read, no horror read by eye.
